text: Every auto-ship in the practice is on one list. A failing card shows up here before a pet runs out.
The red number on Auto-ships counts the ones with a payment problem.
Each one shows who it's for, the item, the price and how often it ships.
Check payment problems every week. Only managers change the price, quantity or item.
Payment problems shows failing cards, auto-ships Stripe ended, and cancels Stripe hasn't confirmed.
Payment failing: the card needs updating. Call the client. They can update it in the portal, or read you a new card.
To enter it for them, click Card.
Type in the new card.
Use this new card. Saving it retries the missed charge right away.
The card is updated.
Back to active.
Pause holds an auto-ship, for a trip, for example.
Pick when it starts again.
Pause it.
It moves to paused, with the date it starts again.
Riley, on the mail order team, opens Edit.
Item and quantity are locked for the team. If they look wrong, don't ship it as is: send a prescription back to the doctor, or ask a manager.
Riley can change how often it ships.
Close without changing.
Robin, a manager, opens the same auto-ship.
Robin can change the item and quantity. A change in price charges or refunds the difference.
Close without changing.
Cancel stops an auto-ship for good.
The most common mistakes: cancelling when the card failed, instead of updating the card, and changing a price as a team member.
Remember: check payment problems every week. Only managers change an auto-ship's price, quantity or item.
